## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] The non-corpus regression suite passes, or any omitted shard is explained.
- [ ] GUI changes were exercised with `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen` and interactively when needed.
- [ ] No recording, project, recovery snapshot, credential, or generated build artifact is included.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and release notes are updated when applicable.

## Risk and recovery

Describe data-loss, compatibility, threading, or performance risks and how the change can be
reverted safely.
